purpose: Static low-poly catalog candidate, not release approval.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every exact final view including rear/bottom for readability and visible coplanar overlap. Actual concept hero/side/top inspected. Keep blade taper and terminal cone. Correct its separate round basal bulbs to one integrated lobed rhizophore; simplify huge root network. Do not copy oversized broad palm-like leaves or regular alternating rows: use narrow linear blades in a golden-angle helix. Some lower leaf loss is illustrative, not a claim of an exactly preserved plant.

Verify One stout tapering unbranched herbaceous axis with long separate linear upper leaves and triangular clasping bases in spiral arrangement. Single dominant elongated terminal strobilus with helically arranged oval-obovate sporophyll relief, not woody pine cone scales. Swollen four-lobed rhizophore with downward roots and sparse lower-stem leaves/scars, no tree branches. A conservative exterior whole-plant P. sternbergii concept informed by Looy et al.2021 fossils and reconstruction, not P. jiaochengensis, P. longicaulis or exact specimen cast. Approximate1.45m including roots is artistic, below reported maximum; precise leaf retention, root count, strobilus proportions and colors not established. Interior anatomy, sex/spore ultrastructure and habitat are not modeled.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
